# Compiler-generated struct/array hashing and equality use pointer operations
# but must remain callable in isolates. Application unsafe guards still apply.
[short] skip
[compiler:gccgo] skip
go build -o check$GOEXE ./host
exec ./check$GOEXE
stdout '^generated equality and hash passed$'
[race] go build -race -o check-race$GOEXE ./host
[race] exec ./check-race$GOEXE
[race] stdout '^generated equality and hash passed$'

-- go.mod --
module example.org/structeq
go 1.26
-- jobs/jobs.go --
package jobs

import "reflect"

type key struct { Name string; Kind int32; Type reflect.Type }

//go:isolate
func Probe() (string,error) {
 a:=key{"owned",3,reflect.TypeFor[int64]()}
 b:=key{"owned",3,reflect.TypeFor[int64]()}
 var x,y any=a,b
 if x!=y { panic("interface struct equality changed") }
 values:=map[key]int{a:7}
 if values[b]!=7 { panic("struct hashing/lookup changed") }
 pair:=[2]key{a,b}
 pairs:=map[[2]key]int{pair:9}
 if pairs[[2]key{b,a}]!=9 { panic("array hashing/lookup changed") }
 return "ok",nil
}
-- host/main.go --
package main

import (
 "fmt"
 "isolate"
 "example.org/structeq/jobs"
)

func main(){
 handle,ok:=isolate.LookupFunction(jobs.Probe)
 if !ok { panic("missing marked function") }
 program:=handle.ProgramWithHandle(func(handle isolate.Handle){
  if err:=handle.Invoke(func(...isolate.Value)error{return nil},func(values ...isolate.Value)error{
   _,err:=isolate.Call(1,[]byte(values[0].Value.(string)))
   return err
  });err!=nil{panic(err)}
 })
 instance,err:=isolate.New(isolate.Config{Program:program,Deterministic:true})
 if err!=nil{panic(err)}
 if err:=instance.Start();err!=nil{panic(err)}
 select {
 case command:=<-instance.Commands():
  if string(command.Payload)!="ok"{panic("wrong result")}
  command.Reply(nil,nil)
 case <-instance.Done():panic(instance.Wait())
 }
 if err:=instance.Wait();err!=nil{panic(err)}
 fmt.Println("generated equality and hash passed")
}
